minutes.headline: Commission approved a skate park NOI and several RDAs and compliance certificates; three deck/dock/garage hearings were continued.
minutes.summary: The commission approved an owl prowl, the May 17th minutes, and heard many wetlands matters. It approved a drainage RDA, the skate park NOI, a tree-removal RDA, and four certificates of compliance. It continued the Korea garage, Eaton deck and Beers dock hearings, and discussed the conservation office staffing shortage, emergency orders and Hollis Road trim painting.

what_happened.line: The commission approved the skate park notice of intent at 100 Chestnut Street with standard conditions, by roll call.
It issued negative determinations on the Electric Ave drainage RDA and the Mascarelli tree removal RDA at 131 Island Road.
It approved four certificates of compliance, with one abstention on the Sunset Lane certificate.
The Korea garage, Eaton deck and Sunset Lane dock hearings were each continued to a September date.
Members heard that the conservation office lacks a full-time head and has a large hours deficit; HR discussed a part-time hire.

why_it_matters: Permits for docks, decks, garages and tree work near wetlands are slowed when the conservation office is short of staff, and one applicant was told a certificate of compliance was deferred for that reason.

The commission also capped a Hollis Road painting job at trim only this fiscal year because the combined quotes passed a ten thousand dollar limit, a purchasing threshold that shapes how town building upkeep is split up.
watch_next: Continued hearings on the Korea garage and 205 Sunset Lane dock return on 9/6, and the Eaton deck hearing on 9/20.
The mushroom signage disclaimer wording is tabled to the next meeting.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the owl prowl, the Electric Avenue RDA, the Masciarelli RDA and the four certificates of compliance. They differ on three continuance votes that the official minutes do not record as votes, and on how the skate park vote went. A reader should check the skate park vote first: our captions say Chris could not vote, and the official minutes say the vote was unanimous.
